title: Entry
description: One transcript entry as the platform read it. The companion NEVER composes an entry: it maps the platform's bounded read one to one, so nothing here is the companion's opinion.

cursor.description: Opaque position, ordered by the platform. A brief's delta is (sinceCursor, throughCursor].

kind.description: KNOWN values: message, tool_line, tombstone. 🔴 Deliberately NOT an enum. Forward compatibility is a requirement of this wire: a reader that meets a kind it does not know renders the entry as a labelled line rather than failing, and wave 4's summary kind must arrive with no version bump. Closing this enum would make that arrival a breaking change.

text.description: Already flattened and bounded by the platform.

label.description: Display label as the platform resolved it.

handle.description: An agent's @slug, so the model can address it by name.

self.description: True when this entry is the answering agent's own. A delta OMITS these; an opener INCLUDES them.
